name: tween
title: Tween
description: Bake and reflow for motion. bake(easing) evaluates an easing curve once (a function such as the Kantar curtain's easeOutCubic, a CSS cubic-bezier() or linear() string from the tokens, or a damped spring) into a plain-JSON table of samples. tween(cache, t) is then a table lookup and one multiply, the same value the curve gives to within 3e-5 for the token curves and 3.3e-4 for the playful spring. still(cache) is the end state, which is all reduced motion shows. Pure, no DOM, runs in Node. Does not replace any existing easing; it holds them as data.

budget.reason: One pure file, counted raw with its comments: the table baker, a cubic-bezier solver, a linear() reader and the closed-form spring, about 7.2 KB.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
